version.description: Schema version. Versions 1 and 2 are accepted; version 2 is current.

exportedAt.description: Unix epoch millis when the export was created.

id.description: Provider item ID. Sanitized on import.

source.description: ContentSource enum name. Validated against known sources on import.

thumbnailUrl.description: HTTPS thumbnail URL. May be blank for SOUND or locator-free local media.

fullUrl.description: HTTPS full-resolution URL. Blank only for locator-free local media.

sourcePageUrl.description: HTTPS link to the original source page.

addedAt.description: Unix epoch millis when the user favorited this item.

sourceAvailability.description: AVAILABLE or SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE. Normalized to AVAILABLE on null/blank.

sourceAvailabilityReason.description: Human-readable reason when source is unavailable.

localMedia.description: True when the media bytes stay on the exporting device and the restored row must offer Relink.

localMediaSha256.description: Optional SHA-256 used to verify a replacement without exposing its original path.

importValidation: id must be non-blank after trim
source must match a known ContentSource enum value
type must be WALLPAPER or SOUND
thumbnailUrl must be HTTPS (may be blank for SOUND type)
fullUrl must be non-blank HTTPS unless localMedia is true
Version 2 localMedia rows use a portable ID, blank locators, and an optional SHA-256 digest
sourcePageUrl, if present, must be HTTPS
sourceAvailability is normalized to AVAILABLE if null or blank
An item count or document size above the shared contract limit refuses the whole import before any database write
Duplicate identities already in the file or target library are counted as skipped; invalid entries are counted as failed

versionPolicy.bumpRule: Increment version when adding required fields or changing field semantics. Optional nullable fields may be added without a version bump.
versionPolicy.forwardCompat: Unknown fields are silently ignored by Moshi. Future versions with higher version numbers are rejected with user-visible copy.
versionPolicy.backwardCompat: Version 1 files remain importable. Version 2 adds locator-free local media metadata.
versionPolicy.unsupportedVersionCopy: This file was exported by a newer version of Aura. Please update the app to import it.

privacyExclusions: Export does not include provider API keys or user credentials
Export does not include download file paths or device storage locations
Local favorite locators are replaced with portable IDs and blank URLs
Export does not include community identity UIDs or Firebase auth state
sourcePageUrl may contain third-party provider URLs with query parameters

version.description: Schema version. Must equal 1 for current parser.

exportedAt.description: Unix epoch millis when the export was created.

collectionName.description: Collection display name, capped at 80 chars on import.

wallpaperId.description: Provider wallpaper ID. Sanitized on import.

importValidation: wallpaperId must be non-blank after trim
source must match a known ContentSource enum value
thumbnailUrl defaults to fullUrl if blank
An item count or document size above the shared contract limit refuses the whole import before any database write
Duplicate wallpaperId+source pairs are counted as skipped; invalid entries are counted as failed

versionPolicy.bumpRule: Increment version when adding required fields or changing field semantics. Optional nullable fields may be added without a version bump.
versionPolicy.forwardCompat: Unknown fields are silently ignored by Moshi. Future versions with higher version numbers are rejected.
versionPolicy.backwardCompat: Version 1 files remain importable. New optional fields default to null on older exports.
versionPolicy.unsupportedVersionCopy: This collection was exported by a newer version of Aura.

privacyExclusions: Export does not include collection creator identity or local IDs
Shared collections via Firebase include creatorUid for ownership rules

library.overflowPolicy: Refuse the whole export or import before opening the destination or writing any restored row.
library.publicationPolicy: Serialize and sync a private staging file before opening an external destination; clean the destination and staging file after a failed or cancelled copy.

portablePreferenceSections.fitCanvasPreferences: Optional static and video Fill or Fit defaults, canvas mode, and opaque custom color. Media files and generated canvas images are not included.
portablePreferenceSections.soundShufflePoolsJson: Named ringtone, notification, and alarm pools with targets and intervals. Local and downloaded assignments keep identity and metadata but omit locators. History and media bytes are not included.

portableDataSections.rotationExclusions: Optional persistent wallpaper and video rotation exclusions. Provider IDs, local content hashes, and one-way locator fingerprints preserve choices without exporting device paths.
portableDataSections.favoritesAndCollections: Local entries use one portable identity across favorites and collection membership. Their original locators are blank after restore until Relink succeeds.
portableDataSections.localWallpapers: Locator-free identity, dimensions, content hash, tags, and target for local wallpapers. Restored entries remain visible and ask the user to relink a file or folder.
portableDataSections.wallpaperHistory: Recent wallpaper history. Device-local entries keep portable identity and metadata while their private locators are omitted.
portableDataSections.contactRingtones: Optional. One row for each contact ringtone set through Aura, described under contactRingtones below.

contactRingtones.source: Aura's own record of the contact ringtones it set. Aura holds no permission to read contacts, so the contact list is never queried to build a backup. A ringtone set in the Contacts app or by another app is not in the record and is not exported.

contactLookupKey.description: The contact's lookup key at the time the ringtone was set. Tried first on import.

contactDisplayName.description: The contact's display name at the time the ringtone was set. Used when the lookup key finds nobody.

soundSource.description: ContentSource enum name of the sound. Blank when unknown.

soundId.description: The id the sound has at its source. Blank for a sound picked from the phone's own storage.

soundTitle.description: The sound's title, shown in the import report.

soundFileName.description: Bare name of the ringtone file Aura saved, with no folder. Lets a restore on the same phone reuse the file.

soundUrl.description: HTTPS address the sound was fetched from. Blank for YouTube, TikTok, bundled and local sounds, which are fetched again from the id.

soundPageUrl.description: HTTPS link to the sound's source page.

soundLicense.description: License label, kept so the same license rules apply on restore.

assignedAt.description: Unix epoch millis when Aura set the ringtone.

importMatching: The contact whose lookup key equals contactLookupKey is tried first
When that key finds nobody, the one contact whose display name equals contactDisplayName exactly is used
A display name shared by two or more contacts is reported as ambiguous and no contact is changed
The contact is looked for before its sound, so nothing is downloaded for a contact that is not on the phone
A sound that is not on the phone and cannot be fetched again from its source is reported as a missing sound

One import downloads at most MAX_CONTACT_RINGTONE_DOWNLOADS sounds and MAX_CONTACT_RINGTONE_DOWNLOAD_BYTES bytes in all. Rows past that are reported, and importing the backup again carries on with them
With the Wi-Fi only setting on and a metered connection, no sound is downloaded and the rows that needed one are reported as waiting for Wi-Fi
Every row that was not restored is named in the import report, and the rest of the import is unaffected
A row with no contact or no sound is counted as failed, and a second row for the same contact is counted as skipped
Without permission to update contacts, every row is reported as waiting on that permission and nothing else in the import is held back
privacyNotes: Rows carry the lookup key and display name of contacts the user gave a ringtone through Aura, and nothing else about them
No contact row id, raw contact id, phone number, email address, or photo is exported
No media library row id, content URI, or file path is exported
The backup is a local file the user saves. Aura does not upload it

resultCounts.exportedOrImported: Rows and non-empty preference sections actually written, including contact ringtones that were set again
resultCounts.skipped: Duplicate or migrated rows intentionally not written
resultCounts.failed: Invalid or device-only rows that could not be restored, and contact ringtones that could not be set again

privacyExclusions: Library backups do not include provider API keys or user credentials
Library backups do not include device-local downloaded media bytes
Local media locators are replaced with portable IDs before export
Library backups do not include raw paths or URLs from rotation exclusions
Sound pool assignments never include content URIs, file paths, applied system URIs, or activity history
Contact ringtone rows never include a contact row id, a phone number, a media row id, a content URI, or a file path
Legacy device-local download rows are reported but not restored

versionPolicy.current: Version 4 adds locator-free named sound shuffle pools and their target schedules. The optional contactRingtones section was added to version 4 without a version bump.
versionPolicy.backwardCompat: Versions 1, 2, and 3 remain importable. Version 1 download rows are reported as device-only instead of being silently discarded. A backup without contactRingtones imports as before.
versionPolicy.forwardCompat: A version newer than 4 is rejected before any database or preference write. An older Aura build ignores the contactRingtones section and restores the rest.
